scripts.features:
ProjectTrash by Blue & Luareflection

ZERO work.ink, linkvertise, etc on this script! Just a key in the discord server!

Auto Kidnap Femboys - Automatically kidnap femboys while you AFK!

Auto Teleport to Base - Instantly return to base after each kidnap
Femboy Spawn Notifications - Get alerted when new femboys appear!

💰
 MONEY MANAGEMENT
Auto Collect Money - Automatically collect money from your base
Instant Steal - No more hold times, instant kidnapping!
Auto Rebirth - Automatically rebirth when you have enough cash

⚡
 QUICK ACTIONS
Kidnap All Femboys - Mass kidnap everyone in the field!
Kidnap Highest Value - Target the most valuable femboy first
Sell All Femboys - Instantly sell all captured femboys

🗺️
 TELEPORT SYSTEM

Quick Base Return - Instantly return to your own base

🏃
 PLAYER ENHANCEMENTS
Custom WalkSpeed (16-200)
Custom JumpPower (50-200)
NoClip - Walk through walls!
Infinite Jump - Never stop jumping!
Auto-apply settings after respawn

🛠️

🎨
